title: Koylufix
description: A lightweight Paper plugin that resets villager trade demands and eliminates artificial price inflation.
body:
## Koylufix
A lightweight Paper plugin designed to give server administrators full control over villager mechanics. 

### Features
* **Toggleable Demand Fix:** Prevent villagers from inflating prices when items are bought in large quantities.
* **Toggleable Discount Fix:** Reset or lock special prices gained from curing zombie villagers or completing raids.
* **In-game Commands:** Switch features on/off instantly without restarting the server.
* **Config File:** Automatically generates a `config.yml` to save your preferences permanently.

### Commands & Permissions
* `/koylufix demand <on/off>` - Toggles trade price inflation fix.
* `/koylufix discount <on/off>` - Toggles special villager discount fix.
* `/koylufix reload` - Reloads the configuration file.
* **Permission:** `koylufix.admin` (Required to use commands).
